Let's analyze the `beer_market` data:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

beer_markets <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/beer_markets_all_cleaned.csv"
)
```


```{r}
#| results: asis
rmarkdown::paged_table(beer_markets) 
```

# This data set describes the beer market and contains information on quantity, brand, dollar_spent, beer_floz, price_floz, and container.  Throughout this blog post, I will explore how different beer brands compare to one another.

```{r}
beer_markets %>%
  summarise(
    mean_price = mean(price_floz, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price_floz, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price_floz, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
```{r}
filtered<- beer_markets %>%
  filter(brand == "BUD_LIGHT")
brand_desc <- filtered %>%
  count(quantity) %>%
  arrange(n)
```

```{r}
beer_markets %>%
  group_by(brand) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(price_floz, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(price_floz, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```
```{r}
# Regression Model
model <- lm(price_floz ~ dollar_spent + quantity + brand, data = beer_markets)
summary(model)
```
